findings.title: HPA names its target with a kind or apiVersion the cluster does not serve
findings.cause: HPA web names its target as kind Deployment in apiVersion extensions/v1beta1, and the cluster serves no Deployment in API group "extensions", so the HPA cannot read or set the replicas of web and scales nothing (Deployments are served from apps/v1)

evidence.detail: the HPA controller was unable to get the target's current scale: no matches for kind "Deployment" in group "extensions"

evidence.what: scaleTargetRef: apiVersion extensions/v1beta1, kind Deployment, name web
evidence.command: kubectl get hpa web -n kd-hpa-target-old-apiversion -o jsonpath='{.spec.scaleTargetRef}'

findings.fix: Set scaleTargetRef.apiVersion to apps/v1: Deployments are served from apps/v1, and extensions/v1beta1 is an old version the API no longer serves.
